title: GPT 5.6 Sol is crazy! Paintball game with splash effects.
author: shottycoin
selftext:
Hey,   
  
today I tried GPT 5.6 Sol via Pixelfork.  It surprised me with the splash effect. I was thinking of generating seperate splash effects with gpt image 2, however AI created this by itself. It looks so good. and it's one-shot. 

`Prompt: Just want to create a FPS Paintball game. where I'm using paintball weapon then shooting walls and etc. i will provide paint ball splash effect on the hit to the objects. i will provide the splash image or you can define it with code. it should be like real paint splash when hit to object.`

Playable link: [https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/208769f0-3811-40cf-b411-1bca8661f199](https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/208769f0-3811-40cf-b411-1bca8661f199)
